title: Predicting 90-day risk of urinary tract infections following urostomy in bladder cancer patients using machine learning and explainability
summary: The primary study develops retrospective ML prediction of 90-day UTI risk after urostomy in a defined bladder-cancer cohort with follow-up; its single-center predictive result does not establish prospective benefit. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
